summary: One blocking finding is valid and should be repaired by specifying acceptance-review routing fields for still_open user-decision deferred findings.

items.title: Specify acceptance-review routing fields for user-decision deferred findings
items.target: R7 / Acceptance Criteria: acceptance-review verdict for still_open deferred findings
items.rationale: R7 asks acceptance-review to emit user_decision_required for still_open deferred findings but does not specify the required nextAction and targetStep fields needed for a valid non-pass acceptance-review artifact.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[6].desc and acceptance_criteria[7] mention user_decision_required but do not name nextAction=user_decision or targetStep=implement.
